assessment.subject: Cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema)
assessment.object: placebo, adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes
assessment.claim_summary: Phase 3a double-blind RCT: once-weekly cagrilintide-semaglutide reduced body weight 13.7% vs 3.4% with placebo over 68 weeks in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes.

assessment.subject: Cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema)
assessment.object: placebo, adults with overweight or obesity
assessment.claim_summary: Phase 3a double-blind RCT: cagrilintide-semaglutide reduced body weight 20.4% vs 3.0% with placebo at 68 weeks in adults with overweight or obesity.

assessment.subject: Inflammatory bowel disease management guidelines (BSG 2025)
assessment.object: adults, UK/NHS clinical practice
assessment.claim_summary: Updated 2025 British Society of Gastroenterology consensus guidelines for management of inflammatory bowel disease in adults; recommendations, not a novel empirical result.

assessment.subject: Retatrutide (triple GLP-1/GIP/glucagon agonist)
assessment.object: obesity and type 2 diabetes pharmacotherapy
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative review concludes retatrutide produces significant dose-dependent weight loss and glycemic improvement across preclinical and early-phase clinical studies.

assessment.subject: BPC-157 (body protection compound-157)
assessment.object: musculoskeletal injury healing, orthopaedic sports medicine
assessment.claim_summary: Systematic review of 36 mostly preclinical studies suggests BPC-157 may promote musculoskeletal injury recovery; human clinical and safety data are minimal.
assessment.magnitude: 7 of 12 patients reported pain relief >6 months (single case series)

assessment.subject: BPC-157 (synthetic pentadecapeptide)
assessment.object: musculoskeletal healing
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative/scoping review: BPC-157 shows robust regenerative effects in preclinical models but only three pilot human studies exist; should be considered investigational.

assessment.subject: Thymosin beta 4 (Tβ4 / TMSB4X)
assessment.object: Alzheimer disease, iPSC cerebral organoids and 5xfAD mice
assessment.claim_summary: In familial-AD iPSC cerebral organoids TMSB4X/Tβ4 was reduced and Tβ4 treatment rescued neurodevelopmental deficits and Aβ formation, with corroboration in 5xfAD mice.

assessment.subject: Anti-obesity incretin pharmacotherapy (GLP-1 RAs, tirzepatide, CagriSema, retatrutide)
assessment.object: obesity / weight management
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative review: second-generation incretin-based anti-obesity drugs achieve 15-25% weight loss, approaching bariatric surgery outcomes.
assessment.magnitude: 15-25% weight loss across agents; tirzepatide up to 22.5%

assessment.subject: Semaglutide and tirzepatide
assessment.object: sitagliptin (placebo proxy), cardiometabolic HFpEF
assessment.claim_summary: Emulated-trial cohort studies of US claims data: semaglutide (HR 0.58) and tirzepatide (HR 0.42) cut HF hospitalization or all-cause mortality >40% vs sitagliptin; tirzepatide not superior to semaglutide.

assessment.subject: Octreotide (somatostatin analogue)
assessment.object: direct/indirect lung injury, ARDS, lung fibrosis
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative review of 44 articles concludes octreotide appears protective in direct/indirect lung injury via anti-inflammatory, anti-secretory and anti-fibrotic effects.

assessment.subject: Anti-obesity medications (orlistat, phentermine, GLP-1 RAs, tirzepatide, pipeline agents)
assessment.object: obesity pharmacotherapy
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative review describing mechanisms, efficacy and pipeline of approved and investigational anti-obesity medications as of Feb 2025, endorsing incretin-based efficacy.

assessment.subject: Retatrutide (triple agonist), TRIUMPH trial program
assessment.object: obesity, obstructive sleep apnea, knee osteoarthritis
assessment.claim_summary: Design/rationale paper for the TRIUMPH Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials of retatrutide for obesity, OSA and knee osteoarthritis; no results reported.

assessment.subject: Injectable therapeutic peptides (BPC-157, TB-4/TB-500, CJC-1295+ipamorelin, tesamorelin, GHK-Cu)
assessment.object: orthopaedic and sports medicine applications
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative review: injectable peptides show preclinical promise but lack human clinical evidence; efficacy, safety and dosing for orthopaedic use remain unproven.

assessment.subject: Therapeutic peptides in orthopaedics (BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, ipamorelin, CJC-1295, etc.)
assessment.object: orthopaedic injury management
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative review of molecular mechanisms of therapeutic peptides in orthopaedics; preclinical evidence described as promising but clinical trials are lacking.

assessment.subject: Approved and unapproved therapeutic peptides (AOD-9604, BPC-157, CJC-1295, GHK-Cu, MOTS-C, SS-31, tesamorelin, Tβ4, TB-500)
assessment.object: musculoskeletal injury and athletic performance
assessment.claim_summary: Narrative review of pharmacology, safety and regulatory status of approved/unapproved peptides in sports medicine; favorable animal outcomes but scarce human safety data and potential harm.

assessment.subject: Bradykinin receptors (B1 and B2 subtypes)
assessment.object: receptor pharmacology and inflammation
assessment.claim_summary: Short review summarizing bradykinin receptor pharmacology: B1 and B2 subtypes confirmed via antagonists and cloning, with distinct roles in acute (B2) and chronic (B1) inflammation.

assessment.subject: Octreotide (somatostatin therapy)
assessment.object: bradycardia, nonacromegalic patient with pancreatic fistula
assessment.claim_summary: Case report of octreotide-associated bradycardia/deleterious hemodynamic effects in a nonacromegalic patient; suggests octreotide be considered as a cause of bradycardia.

assessment.subject: SWE-Pruner Pro (in-agent context pruning method)
assessment.object: coding agents; SWE-Bench Verified and Oolong benchmarks vs SWE-Pruner baseline
assessment.claim_summary: SWE-Pruner Pro prunes tool outputs from the agent's own internal representations, saving up to 39% of tokens while preserving quality and improving SWE-Bench Verified +3.8% and Oolong +2.2.
assessment.magnitude: up to 39% token savings; +3.8% SWE-Bench Verified, +2.2 pts Oolong

assessment.subject: HOMIE (human-object centric video personalization framework)
assessment.object: HOCVP tasks; prior subject-driven video generation methods
assessment.claim_summary: HOMIE unifies inter- and intra-subject video personalization via improved MLLM integration and reports state-of-the-art performance on HOCVP tasks (no quantitative metrics in abstract).

assessment.subject: GigaPath-Flash / GigaTIME-Flash (efficient pathology foundation models)
assessment.object: whole-slide pathology and tumor-microenvironment prediction vs GigaPath/GigaTIME
assessment.claim_summary: GigaPath-Flash retains 97% of GigaPath slide-level performance at 50x less compute; GigaTIME-Flash surpasses GigaTIME while running 6x faster with 8x less GPU memory.
assessment.magnitude: 97% of teacher performance at 50x less compute; 6x faster, 8x less memory

assessment.subject: RAG-based policy learning (vector search as nearest-neighbor matching)
assessment.object: causal inference under the potential-outcome framework
assessment.claim_summary: Proposes one-step and two-step RAG-based policy-learning methods, connecting action-specific vector search to nearest-neighbor matching and deriving regret bounds; largely theoretical.

assessment.subject: Window-aggregation extension of PCMCI+ for causal discovery on irregular time series
assessment.object: synthetic irregular event streams vs standard PCMCI+
assessment.claim_summary: Proposed extension of PCMCI+ recovers known causal graphs on synthetic irregularly sampled event streams across SNR levels and substantially outperforms standard PCMCI+.
assessment.magnitude: substantially outperforms standard PCMCI+ (no numeric value)
